mapper.select: select member_id as memberId, city_code as cityCode, category_weights_json as categoryWeightsJson, creator_weights_json as creatorWeightsJson, last_event_at as lastEventAt, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from member_interest_profile where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into member_interest_profile (member_id, city_code, category_weights_json, creator_weights_json, last_event_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{cityCode}, #{categoryWeightsJson}, #{creatorWeightsJson}, #{lastEventAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update city_code = values(city_code), category_weights_json = values(category_weights_json), creator_weights_json = values(creator_weights_json), last_event_at = values(last_event_at), update_time = values(update_time)

insert into member_interest_profile (member_id, city_code, category_weights_json, creator_weights_json, last_event_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{cityCode}, json_set(json_object(), #{categoryPath}, #{weight}), json_object(), #{lastEventAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update city_code = coalesce(values(city_code), city_code), category_weights_json = json_set( case when json_valid(category_weights_json) then category_weights_json else json_object() end, #{categoryPath}, coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract( case when json_valid(category_weights_json) then category_weights_json else json_object() end, #{categoryPath} )) as signed), 0) + #{weight} ), last_event_at = greatest(coalesce(last_event_at, values(last_event_at)), values(last_event_at)), update_time = values(update_time)
